purpose: Revised native-memory candidate for full current-source qualification after retaining the compact-header combination's failed first-creation frame comparison.
cover_policy: No forced GC, reclaim or freezing; ordinary covered pause plus the JVM trim interval.

selection.headers: Omitted from the final candidate: the initial combined first creation added one 21.9 ms standing frame and one 26.3 ms flight frame, aligned with 19.9 ms Mixed GC and 18.6 ms Remark pauses. Both were away from a 60 s trim boundary. This does not identify a sole cause, but the optional 17-23 MiB header heap saving is not needed to test the larger native-memory cuts.
selection.arena_cap: Both pairs saved 182-185 MiB settled and 248-295 MiB post-flight with no standing/flight frames over 17 ms.
selection.native_interval: Both pairs saved 170-206 MiB settled and 184-283 MiB post-flight. One isolated 18.5 ms flight frame makes combined frame qualification necessary.
selection.non_additive: Arena and interval savings overlap; measure the revised combination directly. No additive saving or causal attribution to headers alone is claimed.
selection.excluded: String dedup, LWJGL system allocation, worker limits and FerriteCore lacked consistent additional benefit; forced covered GC exceeded 50 ms, and both frozen returns failed.
